<?php
// E2E probe (test only): a switch for the 3-D Secure setting, plus a scenario suite for the server side of 3-D Secure.
add_action( 'wp_loaded', function () {
	if ( empty( $_GET['cardz3n_e2e'] ) || 'cfg3ds' !== $_GET['cardz3n_e2e'] ) { return; }
	$s = get_option( 'woocommerce_cardz3n_gateway_settings', array() );
	$s['enable_3d_secure'] = ( isset( $_GET['v'] ) && 'yes' === $_GET['v'] ) ? 'yes' : 'no';
	update_option( 'woocommerce_cardz3n_gateway_settings', $s );
	header( 'Content-Type: application/json' ); echo wp_json_encode( array( 'enable_3d_secure' => $s['enable_3d_secure'] ) ); exit;
} );

// E2E probe (test only): a stand-in for the parts of WooCommerce Subscriptions that the gateway calls, plus a scenario suite.
// Gateway HTTP is short-circuited and every request is recorded (secrets are never recorded). Nothing leaves the machine.
if ( isset( $_GET['cardz3n_e2e'] ) && 'suite' === $_GET['cardz3n_e2e'] ) {
	// Must exist before plugins_loaded so the gateway wires its renewal hook.
	if ( ! class_exists( 'WC_Subscriptions' ) ) { class WC_Subscriptions {} }
}

add_action( 'wp_loaded', function () {
	if ( empty( $_GET['cardz3n_e2e'] ) || 'suite' !== $_GET['cardz3n_e2e'] ) { return; }
	header( 'Content-Type: application/json' );
	if ( function_exists( 'wc_load_cart' ) && null === WC()->session ) { wc_load_cart(); }

	$G = array( 'req' => array(), 'subs_of_order' => array(), 'subs_of_renewal' => array(), 'no_vault' => false, 'n' => 0 );
	$GLOBALS['cz_e2e'] = &$G;

	// ---- a stand-in subscription object (a WC_Order that knows its parent order) ----
	if ( ! class_exists( 'CZ_E2E_Subscription' ) ) {
		class CZ_E2E_Subscription extends WC_Order {
			public function get_parent() { $pid = (int) $this->get_meta( '_e2e_parent_id' ); return $pid ? wc_get_order( $pid ) : false; }
		}
	}
	$mk_sub = function ( $parent ) use ( &$G ) {
		$s = new CZ_E2E_Subscription();
		$s->set_payment_method( 'cardz3n_gateway' );
		$s->update_meta_data( '_e2e_parent_id', $parent->get_id() );
		$s->save();
		$G['subs_of_order'][ $parent->get_id() ][ $s->get_id() ] = $s->get_id();
		return new CZ_E2E_Subscription( $s->get_id() );
	};
	$load_subs = function ( $ids ) { $o = array(); foreach ( (array) $ids as $id ) { $o[ $id ] = new CZ_E2E_Subscription( $id ); } return $o; };
	if ( ! function_exists( 'wcs_order_contains_subscription' ) ) {
		function wcs_order_contains_subscription( $order, $types = null ) { return ! empty( $GLOBALS['cz_e2e']['subs_of_order'][ is_object( $order ) ? $order->get_id() : (int) $order ] ); }
		function wcs_get_subscriptions_for_order( $order, $args = array() ) { $id = is_object( $order ) ? $order->get_id() : (int) $order; $o = array(); foreach ( (array) ( $GLOBALS['cz_e2e']['subs_of_order'][ $id ] ?? array() ) as $sid ) { $o[ $sid ] = new CZ_E2E_Subscription( $sid ); } return $o; }
		function wcs_get_subscriptions_for_renewal_order( $order ) { $id = is_object( $order ) ? $order->get_id() : (int) $order; $o = array(); foreach ( (array) ( $GLOBALS['cz_e2e']['subs_of_renewal'][ $id ] ?? array() ) as $sid ) { $o[ $sid ] = new CZ_E2E_Subscription( $sid ); } return $o; }
		function wcs_is_subscription( $x ) { return $x instanceof CZ_E2E_Subscription; }
	}
	$mk_renewal = function ( $sub, $currency = 'USD' ) use ( &$G ) {
		$r = wc_create_order();
		$r->set_payment_method( 'cardz3n_gateway' );
		$r->set_currency( $currency );
		$r->set_total( '5.00' );
		$r->set_billing_email( 'e2e@example.test' );
		$r->save();
		$G['subs_of_renewal'][ $r->get_id() ][ $sub->get_id() ] = $sub->get_id();
		return $r;
	};

	// ---- the gateway's HTTP, recorded and answered ----
	add_filter( 'pre_http_request', function ( $pre, $args, $url ) use ( &$G ) {
		if ( false === strpos( (string) $url, 'transactiongateway' ) ) { return $pre; }
		parse_str( (string) $args['body'], $b );
		$keep = array( 'cavv', 'xid', 'eci', 'cardholder_auth', 'three_ds_version', 'directory_server_id', 'type', 'amount', 'currency', 'customer_vault', 'customer_vault_id', 'initiated_by', 'stored_credential_indicator', 'initial_transaction_id', 'billing_method', 'orderid', 'payment', 'transactionid' );
		$rec  = array();
		foreach ( $keep as $k ) { if ( isset( $b[ $k ] ) ) { $rec[ $k ] = $b[ $k ]; } }
		$rec['has_token'] = isset( $b['payment_token'] );
		$G['req'][] = $rec;
		++$G['n'];
		$type = $b['type'] ?? '';
		$body = 'response=1&responsetext=SUCCESS&authcode=A1&transactionid=TX-' . $G['n'];
		if ( 'sale' === $type && ! empty( $b['customer_vault_id'] ) && (float) ( $b['amount'] ?? 0 ) < 1 ) { $body = 'response=2&responsetext=DECLINE&transactionid=TX-' . $G['n']; }
		if ( 'tok-decline' === ( $b['payment_token'] ?? '' ) ) { $body = 'response=2&responsetext=DECLINE&transactionid=TX-' . $G['n']; }
		if ( in_array( $type, array( 'sale', 'validate' ), true ) && ! empty( $b['payment_token'] ) && 'tok-decline' !== $b['payment_token'] && ( $b['customer_vault'] ?? '' ) === 'add_customer' && ! $G['no_vault'] ) { $body .= '&customer_vault_id=V-' . $G['n'] . '&cc_number=4xxxxxxxxxxx1111&cc_exp=1230&cc_type=visa'; }
		return array( 'headers' => array(), 'body' => $body, 'response' => array( 'code' => 200, 'message' => 'OK' ), 'cookies' => array(), 'filename' => null );
	}, 10, 3 );

	$gw = WC()->payment_gateways()->payment_gateways()['cardz3n_gateway'];
	$out = array();
	$run = function ( $label, $fn ) use ( &$G, &$out ) {
		$G['req'] = array();
		$res      = $fn();
		$out[ $label ] = array_merge( array( 'requests' => $G['req'] ), (array) $res );
	};
	$order = function ( $total = '5.00', $currency = 'USD' ) {
		$o = wc_create_order();
		$o->set_payment_method( 'cardz3n_gateway' );
		$o->set_currency( $currency );
		$o->set_total( $total );
		$o->set_billing_email( 'e2e@example.test' );
		$o->save();
		return $o;
	};
	$post = function ( $src = 'card', $tok = 'tok-e2e' ) { $_POST = array( 'cardz3n_payment_token' => $tok, 'cardz3n_token_type' => $src, 'cardz3n_payment_source' => $src ); };
	$meta = function ( $o ) { $o = wc_get_order( $o->get_id() ); return array( 'vault' => (string) $o->get_meta( '_cardz3n_customer_vault_id' ), 'initial' => (string) $o->get_meta( '_cardz3n_initial_txn_id' ) ); };
	$hook = 'woocommerce_scheduled_subscription_payment_cardz3n_gateway';

	// 1) Initial subscription purchase: the card is saved without any checkbox; the stored-credential fields are sent.
	$run( 'initial_purchase', function () use ( $gw, $order, $mk_sub, $post, $meta ) {
		$o = $order(); $s = $mk_sub( $o ); $post();
		$r = $gw->process_payment( $o->get_id() );
		return array( 'result' => $r['result'], 'order' => $meta( $o ), 'subscription' => $meta( $s ), 'initial_sub_meta_id' => $s->get_id() );
	} );
	// 2) The FIRST renewal, charged from the saved card.
	$run( 'first_renewal', function () use ( $gw, $order, $mk_sub, $mk_renewal, $post, $meta, $hook, &$G ) {
		$o = $order(); $s = $mk_sub( $o ); $post();
		$gw->process_payment( $o->get_id() );
		$G['req'] = array();
		$r = $mk_renewal( $s );
		do_action( $hook, 5.00, $r );
		$r = wc_get_order( $r->get_id() );
		return array( 'status' => $r->get_status(), 'paid' => $r->is_paid(), 'txn' => (string) $r->get_transaction_id() );
	} );
	// 3) A store whose first order was stamped by an older version: the saved card is only on the first order.
	$run( 'legacy_parent_only', function () use ( $order, $mk_sub, $mk_renewal, $meta, $hook ) {
		$p = $order(); $p->update_meta_data( '_cardz3n_customer_vault_id', 'V-OLD' ); $p->update_meta_data( '_cardz3n_transaction_id', 'TX-OLD' ); $p->save();
		$s = $mk_sub( $p ); $r = $mk_renewal( $s );
		do_action( $hook, 5.00, $r );
		$r = wc_get_order( $r->get_id() );
		return array( 'status' => $r->get_status(), 'subscription_after' => $meta( $s ) );
	} );
	// 4) A renewal that is already paid is never charged again.
	$run( 'already_paid', function () use ( $order, $mk_sub, $mk_renewal, $hook ) {
		$p = $order(); $p->update_meta_data( '_cardz3n_customer_vault_id', 'V-OLD' ); $p->save();
		$s = $mk_sub( $p ); $r = $mk_renewal( $s ); $r->payment_complete( 'TX-PAID' );
		do_action( $hook, 5.00, $r );
		return array( 'status' => wc_get_order( $r->get_id() )->get_status() );
	} );
	// 5) No saved card anywhere: a clear failure, no charge.
	$run( 'no_saved_card', function () use ( $order, $mk_sub, $mk_renewal, $hook ) {
		$p = $order(); $s = $mk_sub( $p ); $r = $mk_renewal( $s );
		do_action( $hook, 5.00, $r );
		$r = wc_get_order( $r->get_id() );
		$notes = array_map( function ( $n ) { return wp_strip_all_tags( $n->content ); }, wc_get_order_notes( array( 'order_id' => $r->get_id() ) ) );
		return array( 'status' => $r->get_status(), 'notes' => $notes );
	} );
	// 6) A declined renewal: the order fails (Subscriptions then applies its own retry rules).
	$run( 'declined_renewal', function () use ( $order, $mk_sub, $mk_renewal, $hook ) {
		$p = $order(); $p->update_meta_data( '_cardz3n_customer_vault_id', 'V-OLD' ); $p->save();
		$s = $mk_sub( $p ); $r = $mk_renewal( $s );
		do_action( $hook, 0.50, $r );
		return array( 'status' => wc_get_order( $r->get_id() )->get_status() );
	} );
	// 7) Renewal in another currency.
	$run( 'renewal_currency_eur', function () use ( $order, $mk_sub, $mk_renewal, $hook ) {
		$p = $order(); $p->update_meta_data( '_cardz3n_customer_vault_id', 'V-OLD' ); $p->save();
		$s = $mk_sub( $p ); $r = $mk_renewal( $s, 'EUR' );
		do_action( $hook, 5.00, $r );
		return array();
	} );
	// 8) Bank payment for a subscription order is refused (card only for now).
	$run( 'ach_refused', function () use ( $gw, $order, $mk_sub, $post ) {
		$o = $order(); $mk_sub( $o ); $post( 'ach' );
		$r = $gw->process_payment( $o->get_id() );
		return array( 'result' => $r['result'] );
	} );
	// 9) A normal order is untouched: no forced save, no stored-credential fields.
	$run( 'normal_order', function () use ( $gw, $order, $post ) {
		$o = $order(); $post();
		$r = $gw->process_payment( $o->get_id() );
		return array( 'result' => $r['result'] );
	} );
	// 10) The gateway returns no saved card for a subscription sign-up: the charge is voided and checkout fails.
	$run( 'no_vault_returned', function () use ( $gw, $order, $mk_sub, $post, &$G ) {
		$G['no_vault'] = true;
		$o = $order(); $mk_sub( $o ); $post();
		$r = $gw->process_payment( $o->get_id() );
		$G['no_vault'] = false;
		return array( 'result' => $r['result'] );
	} );
	// 11) Authorize-only store setting: a subscription sign-up is still a sale; a normal order is an auth.
	$run( 'auth_only_mode', function () use ( $gw, $order, $mk_sub, $post, &$G ) {
		$gw->settings['transaction_mode'] = 'auth';
		$o = $order(); $mk_sub( $o ); $post();
		$gw->process_payment( $o->get_id() );
		$sub_types = array_column( $G['req'], 'type' );
		$G['req'] = array();
		$n = $order(); $post();
		$gw->process_payment( $n->get_id() );
		$gw->settings['transaction_mode'] = 'sale';
		return array( 'subscription_order_types' => $sub_types, 'normal_order_types' => array_column( $G['req'], 'type' ) );
	} );

	// 12) Free trial: nothing is due today. The card is verified and saved, never a $0.00 sale.
	$run( 'free_trial', function () use ( $gw, $order, $mk_sub, $mk_renewal, $post, $meta, $hook, &$G ) {
		$o = $order( '0.00' ); $s = $mk_sub( $o ); $post();
		$r = $gw->process_payment( $o->get_id() );
		$o2 = wc_get_order( $o->get_id() );
		$res = array( 'result' => $r['result'], 'status' => $o2->get_status(), 'paid' => $o2->is_paid(), 'order' => $meta( $o ), 'subscription' => $meta( $s ) );
		$req_signup = $G['req'];
		$G['req'] = array();
		$ren = $mk_renewal( $s ); do_action( $hook, 5.00, $ren );
		$res['signup_requests'] = $req_signup;
		$res['renewal_after_trial'] = $G['req'];
		return $res;
	} );
	// 13) Free trial with a card that is declined: no subscription is activated, nothing is stored.
	$run( 'free_trial_declined', function () use ( $gw, $order, $mk_sub, $post, $meta ) {
		$o = $order( '0.00' ); $s = $mk_sub( $o ); $post( 'card', 'tok-decline' );
		$r = $gw->process_payment( $o->get_id() );
		$o2 = wc_get_order( $o->get_id() );
		return array( 'result' => $r['result'], 'paid' => $o2->is_paid(), 'subscription' => $meta( $s ) );
	} );
	// 14) Free trial with an already saved card: no request at all, the saved card is wired to the subscription.
	$run( 'free_trial_saved_card', function () use ( $gw, $order, $mk_sub, $meta ) {
		$tid = \Cardz3n_Gateway\Token_Service::save_card_token( get_current_user_id(), 'cardz3n_gateway', 'V-SAVED', array( 'last4' => '1111', 'exp_month' => '12', 'exp_year' => '2030', 'brand' => 'visa', 'initial_txn_id' => 'TX-SAVED' ) );
		$o = $order( '0.00' ); $s = $mk_sub( $o );
		$_POST = array( 'wc-cardz3n_gateway-payment-token' => (string) $tid, 'cardz3n_payment_source' => 'card' );
		$r = $gw->process_payment( $o->get_id() );
		$o2 = wc_get_order( $o->get_id() );
		return array( 'result' => $r['result'], 'paid' => $o2->is_paid(), 'subscription' => $meta( $s ), 'token_id' => (int) $tid );
	} );


	// 3DS) server side. The setting is switched through the stored option; the gateway object re-reads it.
	$set3ds = function ( $v ) use ( $gw ) { $s = get_option( 'woocommerce_cardz3n_gateway_settings', array() ); $s['enable_3d_secure'] = $v; update_option( 'woocommerce_cardz3n_gateway_settings', $s ); $gw->init_settings(); };
	$auth = function ( $extra = array() ) { $_POST = array_merge( $_POST, array( 'cardz3n_3ds_status' => 'complete', 'cardz3n_3ds_cavv' => 'CAVV123abc=', 'cardz3n_3ds_eci' => '05', 'cardz3n_3ds_cardholder_auth' => 'verified', 'cardz3n_3ds_version' => '2.2.0', 'cardz3n_3ds_directory_server_id' => 'DS-1', 'cardz3n_3ds_xid' => 'XID.1' ), $extra ); };
	$run( 'on_card_not_authenticated', function () use ( $gw, $order, $post, $set3ds ) {
		$set3ds( 'yes' ); $o = $order(); $post( 'card', 'tok-e2e' );
		$r = $gw->process_payment( $o->get_id() );
		return array( 'result' => $r['result'] );
	} );
	$run( 'on_card_status_not_complete', function () use ( $gw, $order, $post, $set3ds ) {
		$set3ds( 'yes' ); $o = $order(); $post( 'card', 'tok-e2e' ); $_POST['cardz3n_3ds_status'] = 'started'; $_POST['cardz3n_3ds_cavv'] = 'CAVV123';
		$r = $gw->process_payment( $o->get_id() );
		return array( 'result' => $r['result'] );
	} );
	$run( 'on_card_authenticated', function () use ( $gw, $order, $post, $set3ds, $auth ) {
		$set3ds( 'yes' ); $o = $order(); $post( 'card', 'tok-e2e' ); $auth();
		$r = $gw->process_payment( $o->get_id() );
		$notes = array_map( function ( $n ) { return $n->content; }, wc_get_order_notes( array( 'order_id' => $o->get_id() ) ) );
		return array( 'result' => $r['result'], 'notes' => $notes );
	} );
	$run( 'on_card_bad_values_dropped', function () use ( $gw, $order, $post, $set3ds, $auth ) {
		$set3ds( 'yes' ); $o = $order(); $post( 'card', 'tok-e2e' ); $auth( array( 'cardz3n_3ds_cavv' => 'bad value <script>', 'cardz3n_3ds_eci' => str_repeat( '9', 101 ) ) );
		$r = $gw->process_payment( $o->get_id() );
		return array( 'result' => $r['result'] );
	} );
	$run( 'on_wallet_not_authenticated_here', function () use ( $gw, $order, $post, $set3ds ) {
		$set3ds( 'yes' ); $o = $order(); $post( 'apple_pay', 'tok-wallet' );
		$r = $gw->process_payment( $o->get_id() );
		return array( 'result' => $r['result'] );
	} );
	$run( 'off_card_ignores_posted_values', function () use ( $gw, $order, $post, $set3ds, $auth ) {
		$set3ds( 'no' ); $o = $order(); $post( 'card', 'tok-e2e' ); $auth();
		$r = $gw->process_payment( $o->get_id() );
		return array( 'result' => $r['result'] );
	} );
	$run( 'off_card_no_values', function () use ( $gw, $order, $post, $set3ds ) {
		$set3ds( 'no' ); $o = $order(); $post( 'card', 'tok-e2e' );
		$r = $gw->process_payment( $o->get_id() );
		return array( 'result' => $r['result'] );
	} );
	// A subscription: the first payment is authenticated, the renewal (merchant-initiated, ASSUMPTION T4) carries no 3-D Secure values.
	$run( 'subscription_first_then_renewal', function () use ( $gw, $order, $mk_sub, $mk_renewal, $post, $set3ds, $auth, $hook, &$G ) {
		$set3ds( 'yes' ); $o = $order(); $s = $mk_sub( $o ); $post( 'card', 'tok-e2e' ); $auth();
		$first = $gw->process_payment( $o->get_id() );
		$first_reqs = $G['req'];
		$G['req'] = array();
		$r = $mk_renewal( $s );
		do_action( $hook, 5.00, $r );
		$r = wc_get_order( $r->get_id() );
		return array( 'first_result' => $first['result'], 'first_requests' => $first_reqs, 'renewal_status' => $r->get_status(), 'renewal_requests' => $G['req'] );
	} );
	$set3ds( 'yes' );
	$blocks_on_3ds = cardz3n_gw_native_blocks_enabled();
	$set3ds( 'no' );
	$blocks_off_3ds = cardz3n_gw_native_blocks_enabled();
	$out['native_blocks'] = array( 'with_3ds_on' => $blocks_on_3ds, 'with_3ds_off' => $blocks_off_3ds );
	echo wp_json_encode( $out );
	exit;
}, 20 );
